subject: Missed demo today — convert to on-demand + priority next steps
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jason Park <jason@olive-analytics.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Missed demo today — convert to on-demand + priority next steps

Hi Jason,

Sorry we missed you on the call earlier — looks like there was a travel overlap on your side. No problem at all. Two quick options to keep momentum: 1) I can send a short 10–12 minute on-demand recording of the demo that covers the integration and pilot sequence, or 2) we can book a 30-min technical office-hours slot with one of our engineers and your R&D lead to go deeper.

If you want the recording, I can drop it in a shared drive right away and loop in Olivia and any other stakeholders. If you prefer live, give me two 30-min windows that work for you (next 7 business days) and I’ll lock it. Also, tell me which priority you want us to focus on: latency/cost, deployment model (VPC vs hosted), or security/compliance.

Attached: (will attach recording + short pricing summary if you pick the async route)

Thanks — we want to make this low-friction.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0119

Attachments referenced: Redwood_Demo_12min.mp4 (stub); MVP-pricing.pdf (stub)
From: Jason Park <jason@olive-analytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@olive-analytics.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 11:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Missed demo today — convert to on-demand + priority next steps

Hey Ben — apologies, I was stuck in unexpected travel (flight diverted). Thank you for the quick note.

Option 1 (on-demand) sounds best for now so our product folks can watch on their own schedule. If possible, include a 1-slide summary of the recommended pilot scope and the items we should validate during the probe (latency numbers, payload sizing, and data retention behavior). Priya N. (R&D lead) will want to see how the KV cache behaves under our sequence lengths.

Also, we may want a short live follow-up with an engineer next week; Olivia will coordinate availability.

Appreciate the flexibility — Jason
Jason Park
Head of Integrations, Olive Analytics
jason@olive-analytics.com | +1 206-555-0199
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jason Park <jason@olive-analytics.com>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@olive-analytics.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Missed demo today — convert to on-demand + priority next steps

Thanks Jason — understood. I recorded a focused 12-minute walkthrough that covers: architecture footprint, latency numbers on a 4k token sequence, and what the pilot bundle looks like. I also put a single-slide pilot scope (what to validate) and a short pricing summary. Links attached below.

Quick ask: can Priya share one example input size (avg. tokens per request) so we can call that out in the recording? If not, I used 2.2k as a placeholder.

If you want to lock a live slot, here are three 30-min office-hours windows next week (PT):
- Tue Aug 3, 10:00–10:30
- Wed Aug 4, 13:00–13:30
- Thu Aug 5, 10:00–10:30

I’ll attach the recording and the PDF now. Monica — looping you in to help make the office-hours path smooth and to propose a lightweight pilot cadence if they want to proceed.

Link (recording + slide): https://drive.google.com/file/d/REDWOOD_DEMO_12min
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/Olive/OLV-2027-042

Best,
Ben

Attachments: Redwood_Demo_12min.mp4 (stub); MVP-pricing.pdf (stub)
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jason Park <jason@olive-analytics.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@olive-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Missed demo today — convert to on-demand + priority next steps

Hi Jason — Monica here (Solutions). Thanks for the note and glad an async option helps. If you want to move fast after the team watches the recording, I recommend we: 1) schedule a 30-min technical office-hours with our inference engineer to validate the KV/cache behavior and integration hooks, and 2) run a 2-week pilot on a dedicated single-GPU instance so you can evaluate latency at scale with real payloads.

If that works, I’ll:
- Send a calendar invite for the office-hours (pick the window you prefer from Ben’s list).
- Share a short pilot checklist and a one-page SOW (DocuSign link below) to formalize the pilot scope. No heavy purchase required — this is to get metrics and a migration plan.

DocuSign (SOW stub): https://docusign.com/s/OLV-2027-042-pilot

I’ll plan for Priya’s team during the office-hours; please let me know if that works for you and which window you prefer.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai
From: Jason Park <jason@olive-analytics.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@olive-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Missed demo today — convert to on-demand + priority next steps

Monica/Ben — thanks, that all sounds good. We’ll do Option 2: 30-min office-hours first. Availability: Thu Aug 5, 10:00–10:30 PT works well for Priya and me. Please send the invite and the recording link for the wider team.

I reviewed the HubSpot deal and the pilot SOW link — looks fine on our end. I’ll sign once the SOW is in place after the office-hours if the metrics look good.

See you Thu — Jason
